candidates.title: STOP Squatting Your Kettlebell Swings! 😳 Do THIS Instead for Power & Results 🔥
candidates.description:
Most people make this huge mistake when doing kettlebell swings — they bend their knees too much and turn it into a squat 😬

❌ Wrong:

Too much knee bend

Using your legs instead of your hips

No real hip drive = no power

✅ Correct:

Hinge at your hips, not your knees

Push your hips back, keep your chest up, and drive your hips forward

The movement should come from your glutes and hamstrings, not your quads

This is a hip hinge movement, not a squat. When done correctly, it builds explosive strength, glute power, and core stability 💪

⚠️ Real Talk: If your lower back hurts during swings, your form is off — fix your hinge and let your hips do the work!

Remember to subscribe for more form correction and strength training tips!

#KettlebellSwings #FormCorrection #StrengthTraining #GluteWorkout #GoWithJoFitness
